column8: Minidregg.Pred.HashEqDigest.Opening → Prop := fun o => 0 ≤ o.cell ∧ o.cell < 2 ^ 64 ∧ o.valueSlots.length < 2 ^ 32 ∧ o.values.length = o.valueSlots.length ∧ (∀ s ∈ o.valueSlots, (Minidregg.Pred.HashEqDigest.utf8 s).length < 2 ^ 32) ∧ (Minidregg.Pred.HashEqDigest.utf8 o.blinderSlot).length < 2 ^ 32 ∧ (Minidregg.Pred.HashEqDigest.utf8 o.commitSlot).length < 2 ^ 32 ∧ (∀ x ∈ o.values, -2 ^ 255 ≤ x ∧ x < 2 ^ 255) ∧ 0 ≤ o.blinder ∧ o.blinder < 2 ^ 256
ℤ → List String → String → String → List ℤ → ℤ → Minidregg.Pred.HashEqDigest.Opening

∀ (H : Minidregg.Theory.HashBytes.Hash) {a b : Minidregg.Pred.HashEqDigest.Opening}, a.Admissible → b.Admissible → Minidregg.Pred.HashEqDigest.digestWith H a = Minidregg.Pred.HashEqDigest.digestWith H b → a = b ∨ Minidregg.Theory.HashBytes.Collision H

∀ (o : Minidregg.Pred.HashEqDigest.Opening) (values : List ℤ) (blinder : ℤ), values.length = o.values.length → Minidregg.Pred.HashEqDigest.digestWith Minidregg.Pred.HashEqDigest.lengthHash { cell := o.cell, valueSlots := o.valueSlots, blinderSlot := o.blinderSlot, commitSlot := o.commitSlot, values := values, blinder := blinder } = Minidregg.Pred.HashEqDigest.digestWith Minidregg.Pred.HashEqDigest.lengthHash o

∀ {s t : String} {rest rest' : List UInt8}, (Minidregg.Pred.HashEqDigest.utf8 s).length < 2 ^ 32 → (Minidregg.Pred.HashEqDigest.utf8 t).length < 2 ^ 32 → Minidregg.Pred.HashEqDigest.name s ++ rest = Minidregg.Pred.HashEqDigest.name t ++ rest' → s = t ∧ rest = rest'

∀ {l l' : List String} {rest rest' : List UInt8}, (∀ s ∈ l, (Minidregg.Pred.HashEqDigest.utf8 s).length < 2 ^ 32) → (∀ s ∈ l', (Minidregg.Pred.HashEqDigest.utf8 s).length < 2 ^ 32) → l.length = l'.length → Minidregg.Pred.HashEqDigest.names l ++ rest = Minidregg.Pred.HashEqDigest.names l' ++ rest' → l = l' ∧ rest = rest'
∀ {a b : Minidregg.Pred.HashEqDigest.Opening}, a.Admissible → b.Admissible → a.preimage = b.preimage → a = b

∀ (o : Minidregg.Pred.HashEqDigest.Opening), o.preimage.length = 8 + 4 + (Minidregg.Pred.HashEqDigest.names o.valueSlots).length + (4 + (Minidregg.Pred.HashEqDigest.utf8 o.blinderSlot).length) + (4 + (Minidregg.Pred.HashEqDigest.utf8 o.commitSlot).length) + 32 * o.values.length + 32
∀ {s t : String}, Minidregg.Pred.HashEqDigest.utf8 s = Minidregg.Pred.HashEqDigest.utf8 t → s = t
∀ {x y : ℤ}, -2 ^ 255 ≤ x → x < 2 ^ 255 → -2 ^ 255 ≤ y → y < 2 ^ 255 → Minidregg.Pred.HashEqDigest.word x = Minidregg.Pred.HashEqDigest.word y → x = y

∀ {l l' : List ℤ} {rest rest' : List UInt8}, (∀ x ∈ l, -2 ^ 255 ≤ x ∧ x < 2 ^ 255) → (∀ x ∈ l', -2 ^ 255 ≤ x ∧ x < 2 ^ 255) → l.length = l'.length → Minidregg.Pred.HashEqDigest.words l ++ rest = Minidregg.Pred.HashEqDigest.words l' ++ rest' → l = l' ∧ rest = rest'
∀ {a b : ℤ}, 0 ≤ a → 0 ≤ b → a.toNat = b.toNat → a = b
∀ {a : ℤ} {k : ℕ}, 0 ≤ a → a < ↑k → a.toNat < k
